item.title: Skiffle
item.description: Lonnie Donegan’s “Rock Island Line” opens with spoken narration about a toll-dodging freight train, and then the rhythm kicks in: a single acoustic guitar strumming eight-to-the-bar over a walking string bass, with a washboard scraping the backbeat on thimbled fingers.
